title: THE SUPPORT MG SPINS UP AGAIN AFTER YOU ARE DOWNED
why: The Support MG spin only wound down on a standing frame, so going down froze it at whatever it was. Proven in the cloud: spun up to full, downed for seconds, picked up, and the first fresh pull fired at full rate in the first tenth of a second, where a fresh pull from a standstill fires nothing for 0.15 s. v26.60 says a long pause starts the spin over, and a bleed-out is the longest pause there is. Going down now lets the spin go and cuts the whirr, so a pull after a pick-up winds up from the start.
now: After you are picked up the Support MG winds up from the start again.
